jobs.title: Sr. Community Developer (Unannounced Projects)
jobs.desc:
The Senior Community Developer is a leader in creating global community engagement strategies that support player retention inside & outside of their experiences with our games. They will be responsible for establishing and growing our global communities around Ubisoft’s games with a proficiency in player communications, game improvements and feedback cycles, and deployment and maintenance of best practices. As a key strategic partner, they will prioritize global business growth opportunities by collaborating with transversal stakeholders as they lead the global community strategy, creating and executing global plans, and work with a distributed international team that is focused on building relationships and earning trust with players around the world. This position will also provide their expertise to peers and cross functional team members to drive collaborative planning, develop strong synergies, and execute commitments at high quality standards. As a leader in the global community team, this position will be integrated with lead development studios.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Develop and execute community strategic plans through a variety of content tactics which support Production objectives and augment the overall marketing strategy.
 Coordinate communication, activities, and initiatives with multiple global departments for consistent and cohesive messaging.
 Leverage Community Managers, transversal teams, and relevant partner resources to create meaningful content for our players (example: blogs, podcasts, interviews, infographics, & more).
 Act as one of the spokespersons for the assigned brand(s). Coordinate community-centric events including, but not limited to: studio visits from fans, developer dialogues, and tournaments.
 Collaborate with portfolio’s Social Media Manager to define and report on content KPI’s to demonstrate success and ROI of community programs and content.
 Support internal & external milestones, such as betas and launches, to ensure KPIs are met & to advocate for player experience.
 Act as a primary representative for players’ needs within Production and Publishing teams to positively influence development and communications positioning on behalf of our players and business objectives.
 Shape player feedback cycles and provide insights to Production and Publishing teams to influence game experiences, stimulate user retention, and assist in positioning messaging and marketing beats.
 Collaborate and coordinate with live teams for post-launch communication. Set expectations on applicable situations such as patch content, status, and delivery.
 Manage and produce internal reports on community feedback, activity & expectations.
 Serve as an identified subject matter expert for both the project and the wider global Community team, and act as a mentor to Community Managers and peers.
 Operate with an ROI-centric mindset by making calculated decisions that promote efficiency while remaining strategic with available resources.
 Lead the way in defining best practices to drive impact and proactively share these with the wider Community team.
 Identify and capitalize on opportunities for synergies between cross-functional teams.
 Lead transversal initiatives to support department objectives and key results.
 International travel may be required.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING 
 Extensive experience managing online communities and leading the development of strategic plans or programs with demonstrable success.
 Extensive experience in the gaming industry across multiple platforms, genres, and AAA game launches (required); experience with fantasy or RPG titles is a strong asset.
 Experience working on unannounced or early-stage projects, with proven ability to operate with discretion and adapt strategy to evolving creative directions.
 Experience in co-development or third-party project environments, collaborating across studio boundaries to align community efforts with production realities.
 Extensive knowledge of community & social media platforms (Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, Discord, etc.) is required.
 Experience working in a demanding production environment with multiple deadlines, objectives, and stakeholders.
 Proven track record of building and maintaining long-term relationships with studio partners, external stakeholders, and player communities.
 Deep knowledge of, or strong passion for, Western RPG and fantasy games, solid grasp of their communities and player expectations.
 Strong player advocacy mindset: ability to collect, synthesize, and champion player feedback with internal and external partners, and translate it into actionable insights.
 Strong understanding of building and maintaining video game community growth, and developing strategic player engagement plans.
 Capacity to build trust with players over the long term, including on projects that cannot yet be fully disclosed.
 Experience working in a demanding production environment, managing multiple deadlines, success metrics, and cross-functional stakeholders.
 Having shipped or actively supported a AAA live-service title &/or an Early Access is a strong plus.
 Fluency in French.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Back-End), Inference
jobs.loc: Canada / San Francisco / United States / New York / Ottawa / Toronto / Montreal
jobs.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


WHY THIS ROLE?

This role is for a highly experienced Back-End Software Engineer who wants to work on core systems that shape how the platform (Model Vault) operates. You will help define the architecture of the platform where reliability, security, performance, and simplicity all matter, and where many of the problems do not have off-the-shelf solutions.

Model Vault is Cohere’s inference platform for deploying and operating models securely at enterprise scale. The team owns the systems between a customer and the underlying AI infrastructure, including identity, deployments, metering, billing, security, privacy, and confidential computing. We are strengthening these systems as Model Vault grows, with the goal of scaling to millions of users and supporting some of the world’s most demanding enterprise workloads.



AS A SENIOR/STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

 - Evolve and scale the backend systems that power Model Vault, including authentication and authorization, deployment management, billing, metering, and customer lifecycle.

 - Lead major architectural initiatives across identity, payments, usage systems, platform scalability, and other core product foundations.

 - Build highly reliable control-plane services for provisioning, configuring, scaling, and operating model deployments across clouds and hardware platforms.

 - Design APIs and distributed systems with strong guarantees around correctness, consistency, isolation, failure recovery, idempotency, and observability.

 - Build security and privacy into the platform architecture, including tenant isolation, least-privilege access, auditability, secrets management, encryption, and confidential computing boundaries.

 - Solve complex problems that span backend systems, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI inference, where conventional SaaS patterns are often not enough.

 - Drive projects end-to-end, from architecture and threat modeling through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration based on real customer workloads.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You are a strong backend engineer with excellent fundamentals in distributed systems, databases, networking, operating systems, and security.

 - You have strong programming fundamentals and experience building production systems in languages such as Go, Python, Java, C++, Rust, or similar. You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and make thoughtful tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and correctness.

 - You have designed and operated production systems where correctness, availability, security, and performance mattered at significant scale.

 - You can take ambiguous, high-impact technical problems, define the right architecture, and drive them through to reliable production systems.

 - You have strong systems-design instincts and understand concepts such as concurrency, consistency, caching, queues, rate limiting, backpressure, failure domains, idempotency, and graceful degradation.

 - You think deeply about security boundaries and understand authentication, authorization, identity, cryptography, secrets, tenant isolation, and how small implementation choices can create significant security risks.

 - You are comfortable reasoning across backend services, APIs, databases, distributed systems, and the cloud infrastructure they run on.

 - You are comfortable diving into unfamiliar codebases and debugging complex problems that cross service or system boundaries.

 - You care about the details of production engineering, including instrumentation, capacity planning, migrations, backwards compatibility, incident response, and safe rollouts.

 - You are comfortable challenging existing architecture and evolving foundational components when the system’s needs change.

 - You have a track record of taking technically difficult projects from an unclear starting point to systems that other engineers and customers depend on.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.title: Conseiller·ère expert·e cybersécurité intelligence artificielle
jobs.desc:
L’Architecte cybersécurité spécialiste en intelligence artificielle définit et fait évoluer le cadre permettant une adoption sécuritaire, responsable et durable de l’IA au sein de l’organisation. Cette personne est imputable du cadre de gouvernance et de l’architecture de référence de l’IA à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Ses orientations, standards et garde-fous lient l’ensemble des secteurs et ont des répercussions au-delà de son unité.
 Reconnu·e comme expert·e de pointe et référence, tant à l’interne qu’auprès des partenaires et du marché, elle collabore avec la haute direction à l’établissement de la stratégie d’encadrement de l’IA et influence les décisions d’investissement, les arbitrages de portefeuille et l’appétit au risque de l’organisation. Elle assure l’alignement entre les objectifs d’affaires, les architectures technologiques, la cybersécurité, la gouvernance, la conformité et la gestion des risques liés à l’IA générative, aux agent·e·s autonomes et aux plateformes d’IA. Elle anticipe l’évolution des enjeux internes et externes et influence les orientations stratégiques de l’organisation à court, moyen et long terme en matière d’intelligence artificielle.
 PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS
 Définir et faire évoluer les cadres de gouvernance de l’IA : rôles, responsabilités, processus décisionnels, politiques, standards et garde-fous encadrant l’IA générative et les agent·e·s intelligents afin d’éclairer la haute direction quant aux risques et aux opportunités.
 Définir les architectures de référence des plateformes d’IA, des agent·e·s autonomes, des services de modèles et des solutions RAG, et en assurer l’intégration cohérente à l’architecture d’entreprise.
 Identifier et évaluer les risques technologiques, de cybersécurité, opérationnels, réglementaires et éthiques des systèmes d’IA, définir les mesures d’atténuation appropriées et émettre les avis de risques et d’architecture.
 Définir les exigences de sécurité applicables aux modèles, aux agent·e·s, aux données, aux API et aux plateformes d’IA, et promouvoir l’application des principes Security by Design et Responsible AI by Design .
 Définir les contrôles de gestion des identités, de protection des données, de journalisation, de traçabilité et d’observabilité des agent·e·s intelligents.
 Évaluer les risques liés aux fournisseurs d’IA (souveraineté des données, dépendance technologique, concentration des services) et participer à leur sélection et à leur homologation.
 Exercer l’autorité fonctionnelle permettant d’émettre des avis d’architecture et de risques ainsi que de recommander l’homologation, la dérogation, la suspension ou l’arrêt d’une initiative d’IA, et en assumer les conséquences.
 Cerner, définir et résoudre de façon proactive les problèmes les plus complexes du domaine en recourant à des approches novatrices lorsque les solutions existantes sont insuffisantes.
 Contribuer à la surveillance des modèles et des agent·e·s ainsi qu’à la gestion des incidents impliquant l’IA, en collaboration avec les équipes de sécurité et d’opérations.
 Accompagner les secteurs d’affaires et technologiques dans l’adoption responsable de l’IA, agir à titre d’expert·e-conseil auprès de la haute direction et représenter l’organisation auprès des instances de gouvernance, des partenaires, des organismes de réglementation et des fournisseurs d’IA.
 Assurer une veille stratégique des tendances, normes, pratiques émergentes et cadres réglementaires liés à l’intelligence artificielle afin de recommander les ajustements requis aux orientations de l’organisation.
 Définir les mécanismes de gouvernance du cycle de vie des modèles d’IA, incluant leur validation, leur surveillance, la gestion de leur évolution et leur retrait lorsque requis.
Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine pertinent, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience;
 Minimum de 12 années d’expérience en architecture, cybersécurité, gouvernance ou gestion des risques TI, dont 3 années liées à l’IA ou aux technologies émergentes;
 Expérience reconnue d’élaboration d’orientations stratégiques et de cadres de gouvernance dans des environnements complexes et multidisciplinaires;
 Certification pertinente (CISSP, CISM, TOGAF, SABSA ou équivalent), un atout;
 Bilinguisme (français et anglais) L’employé·e aura à communiquer avec des clients·es anglophones et doit s’attendre à communiquer en anglais
Nous valorisons ton unicité ! 
 Nous nous engageons à créer et à maintenir un milieu de travail accessible, équitable et inclusif afin de représenter la diversité au sein de la collectivité dans laquelle l’entreprise évolue.  Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE.  We are seeking a high-energy, goal-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across the Mid-Enterprise sector - including Hospitality, Retail, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Financial Services, and the Public Sector.  Hunter mentality, tenacious, drive to learn, and self-motivated

jobs.title: Technicien·ne multifonctions
Scientifique des données -  Intelligence artificielle générative
jobs.desc:
En tant que scientifique des données à Ubisoft Montréal, vous contribuerez à un produit technologique qui intègre l’intelligence artificielle (IA) générative aux fonctionnalités de nos jeux. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe réunissant des scientifiques des données, de la programmation, de la conception de jeux, de la narration et de l’animation. Ensemble, vous explorerez les possibilités de l’IA générative pour créer des expériences de jeu intéressantes, puis les mettrez à l’essai auprès des joueurs et joueuses.  Ce que vous ferez 
 Définir les objectifs et les protocoles d’évaluation à partir des besoins des équipes de conception et des données des joueurs
 Concevoir des prototypes et entraîner des modèles d’apprentissage automatique pour répondre à ces objectifs
 Collaborer avec les spécialistes en apprentissage automatique pour transférer les prototypes et établir les critères de réussite de leur intégration
 Examiner avec les équipes de conception les comportements des systèmes d’IA et les possibilités d’améliorer le jeu
 Repérer des possibilités d’expérimentation et d’innovation
 Présenter vos travaux et vos résultats de façon claire à des publics variés
Ce que vous apportez à l'équipe
 Apporter une expérience en science des données acquise dans des projets liés à des produits interactifs, comme des jeux, des applications ou des systèmes en temps réel
 Utiliser Python et TensorFlow ou PyTorch
 Appliquer des connaissances en statistiques et en méthodes d’évaluation, notamment l’exploration de données, les tests statistiques et les tests comparatifs entre deux versions
 Examiner des données complexes et séquentielles provenant de systèmes interactifs
 Mettre à profit vos connaissances des grands modèles de langage
 Traduire les besoins des clients en spécifications grâce à votre écoute et à votre compréhension, tout en organisant votre travail et en nourrissant votre intérêt pour le jeu vidéo
 Communiquer en anglais, à l’écrit et à l’oral, avec des interlocuteurs de différents pays, comme le demande la collaboration internationale liée au poste
 Une expérience avec PySpark est un atout.
 Ce qu’il faut nous envoyer
 Envoyer votre CV mettant en valeur vos compétences et votre expérience pertinentes
 Présenter des liens vers des projets pertinents en science des données ou en apprentissage automatique

We're hiring a Chief of Staff to keep Cohere's AI organization running at full speed. You'll report to and support the Chief AI Officer and work to bridge across all teams and functions at Cohere (including research, modelling, product, delivery, security, sales and operations). In any given quarter, the org ships new AI product demos and releases, customer pilots and scaled solutions, security updates, often across regions and time zones. Your job is to make sure the right work priorities win when everything feels urgent, that our plans turn into high-quality shipped work, and that our Chief AI Officer can focus on leading instead of firefighting.

Much of this is operational: the planning calendar, the budget, the headcount plan, the weekly business reviews, the communication strategy (internal and external), the cross-functional handoffs.  Your role is the operating rhythm of the org: meetings, priorities, plans, and the decisions that come out of them.  You will be a member of an experienced, high-performing and supportive leadership team.

Own the operating rhythm and planning: annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, and the weekly and monthly business reviews. Drive budget and headcount planning against the slate, and keep both honest as priorities shift mid-quarter.

Keep major programs from colliding or stalling across research, modelling, product, delivery, and security.  Be the person teams come to when it isn't clear who owns a decision, or how to navigate trade-offs.

Be the connective tissue between the Chief AI Officer’s org and the rest of the company: cross-functional planning with product, engineering, security, and finance, so the org's commitments are realistic and its dependencies are visible.

Own and lead special projects: Lead the things that don't fit neatly on any one team's plate: a reorg, a new partnership, a flagship research event, an org-wide planning week. Own them end to end.

You have 12+ years of operating experience, with real time inside an AI/ML organization in a Chief of Staff, business operations, or senior program-operations seat. At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft Urban Solutions (LUS) creates bikeshare programs that riders love, cities need, and operators value. We design, build and support the bikes and stations technology behind bikeshare programs in cities around the world, including Bixi. Our Montreal team sits at the heart of that work, bringing together engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, marketing and commercial teams under one roof.
 As the People Business Partner for LUS, you'll be the go-to people partner, and will also serve as the primary People lead for the Montreal site. You'll translate business priorities into practical people plans, help managers lead through complex people issues, and make sure our programs land properly in a Quebec context. You'll report into the Senior People Business Partner for our Global Growth team, and work closely with Employee Relations, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, People Operations and Legal.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys being close to the business. Success looks like a deep understanding of the team’s objectives, metrics, performance, and opportunities in order to craft People strategies that enable those objectives. You are equally comfortable coaching a new manager through a difficult conversation and helping a director think through how their team should be structured next year.
 Responsibilities: 
 Partnering with managers and leaders across LUS on team health, performance, development and retention, providing thought partnership that's direct, practical and grounded in the business.
 Leading the People responsibilities for the Montreal site, including liaising with CNESST, the OQLF, and running the 1% Training Law program.
 Manage people rhythms autonomously and with excellence: bringing performance reviews, compensation cycles, talent reviews, workforce planning, organizational health reporting and engagement surveys to life for your client groups, and making sure managers are ready for each.
 Supporting employee relations matters with care and sound judgement, from first conversation through to resolution, partnering with Employee Relations and Legal where cases are complex.
 Supporting organizational changes, from small team restructures to larger shifts in how LUS is organized, including planning, manager preparation, project management and team member communication.
 Applying Quebec employment law and practice to Lyft's global programs, and flagging early where something needs to be adapted locally.
 Using data to spot patterns, such as attrition, engagement and hiring trends, and bringing them to leaders with a clear view on what to do next.
 Partnering with Finance to track headcount cost, holding leaders accountable and advising on headcount shifts to remain neutral to budget while optimizing for business outcomes.
 Being a visible, trusted presence on site, particularly for teams who don't sit at a desk all day.
 Experience: 
 5+ years of HR experience, including at least 2–3 years in an HR business partner or generalist role supporting managers directly.
 Working knowledge of Quebec employment law and experience applying it in practice.
 Professional fluency in French and English, written and spoken. 
 Solid experience handling employee relations matters, including investigations, performance management and exits.
 Experience supporting both salaried, corporate employees and hourly, frontline and / or site-based populations.
 Experience in a company going through integration, restructuring or significant growth preferred.

 Family building benefits
 Pet benefits

jobs.title: Coordonnateur·rice à la grille de programmation
Développe à Ubisoft - Programme de mentorat - Cybersécurité 2026-2027
jobs.desc:
Développe à Ubisoft est un programme de mentorat destiné aux étudiantes et aux récentes diplômées (ayant moins de deux ans d'expérience) qui souhaitent développer leurs compétences en conception de jeux, en audio, en programmation ou en cybersécurité.
Cette initiative soutient les personnes de genres historiquement sous-représentés dans l'industrie du jeu vidéo et dans les domaines des STIM (sciences, technologies, ingénierie et mathématiques).
 Développe à Ubisoft est l'un des nombreux programmes de talents que nous offrons pour mobiliser et soutenir différents publics au sein de l'industrie.
 Veuillez noter que ce programme est un programme de mentorat et n'est associé à aucun processus d'embauche. 
 De janvier à mai 2027, les mentorées sélectionnées travailleront sur un projet basé sur un thème donné. Elles seront accompagnées par des développeuses bénévoles d'Ubisoft, notamment de nos studios mobiles, qui offriront des rétroactions et des conseils tout au long du mentorat afin de les aider à faire progresser leur propre projet personnel.
 Dans le volet Cybersécurité , vous réaliserez une série de défis Capture the Flag (CTF) simulant des scénarios de sécurité réels. Vous enquêterez sur des vulnérabilités, analyserez des systèmes et résoudrez des défis techniques, tout en développant des compétences pratiques en cybersécurité sous la supervision de professionnelles en cybersécurité d'Ubisoft.
Critères d'admissibilité : 
 Être âgée d'au moins 18 ans
 Être actuellement inscrite à des études, ou avoir obtenu son diplôme au printemps 2024 ou après
 Avoir moins de 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle
 Être légalement autorisée à travailler dans le pays où la candidature est soumise
 Les candidatures ne peuvent être soumises que pour un seul emplacement
 Seules les candidatures individuelles sont acceptées – les candidatures d'équipe ne seront pas considérées
 Ce programme vise à soutenir les professionnelles en début de carrière de genres sous-représentés dans l'industrie – femmes et personnes non binaires. En soumettant votre candidature, vous confirmez répondre aux critères d'admissibilité mentionnés ci-dessus et les accepter. 
 Soumettez votre candidature avec votre CV et une lettre de motivation .
 Veuillez noter que ce volet est réservé aux candidates résidant à Montréal, au Québec.
Période de candidature : du 1ᵉʳ au 31 octobre

jobs.desc:
Chez Lyft, notre raison d'être est de servir et de connecter. Lyft Urban Solutions conçoit, fabrique et exploite des systèmes de vélopartage dans plus de 50 villes à travers le monde, dont New York, Chicago, Londres, Barcelone, Mexico, Rio de Janeiro et Montréal. Notre usine de Longueuil est le berceau de BIXI, le premier système de vélopartage automatisé en Amérique du Nord, et fabrique aujourd'hui les vélos et les stations de certains des plus grands réseaux de vélopartage au monde.
 Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire en ingénierie de la qualité terrain, matériel pour se joindre à notre équipe Qualité terrain (Field Quality) à notre établissement de Longueuil. Une fois que nos vélos, vélos électriques, batteries et stations quittent l'usine, l'équipe Qualité terrain est responsable de leur comportement en conditions réelles : des millions de trajets, en toutes saisons, dans des villes partout dans le monde. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'ingénieurs en qualité terrain pour aider à détecter les problèmes matériels émergents, à en investiguer la cause profonde et à soutenir la mise en place de correctifs avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et des opérations dans les marchés.  Soutenir les analyses de défaillance sur des pièces retournées du terrain, y compris les demandes des clients entreprises, en participant au démontage, à l'inspection et aux essais électriques et en documentant les constats avec photos.
 Aider à surveiller les données terrain, comme les alertes des véhicules et des stations et les historiques de réparation, et signaler les problèmes émergents à l'équipe.
 Concevoir et mettre à jour des tableaux de bord et des requêtes pour suivre les indicateurs de fiabilité et l'avancement des mises à niveau.
 Participer aux campagnes de mise à niveau sur le terrain en aidant à repérer les unités touchées et en suivant l'avancement.
 Aider à réviser les PON de réparation et les guides de diagnostic utilisés par les mécaniciens des marchés, et proposer des améliorations.
 Contribuer aux enquêtes sur les défaillances terrain dans Jira, en collaboration avec les ingénieurs, pour l'analyse des causes profondes et les mesures correctives.

 Être inscrit ou inscrite à un programme de baccalauréat ou de maîtrise en génie mécanique, électrique, mécatronique ou industriel, ou dans un domaine connexe, dans une université canadienne, avec une fin d'études prévue entre décembre 2027 et l'été 2028 (obligatoire) .  Solides compétences analytiques et aisance à travailler avec de grands ensembles de données imparfaits pour en tirer des conclusions claires

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. Lyft Urban Solutions designs, builds, and operates bikeshare systems in more than 50 cities worldwide, including New York, Chicago, London, Barcelona, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro, and Montréal.  Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field, at a Canadian university, graduating between December 2027 and summer 2028 (required) .  Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets to reach clear conclusions

jobs.title: Product Security Engineer, North Security
jobs.loc: Toronto / Calgary / Boston / Canada / Seattle / New York / Vancouver / California / Ottawa / Montreal
jobs.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




WHY THIS ROLE

Enterprises hand Cohere their most sensitive data and put our models inside workflows they can't afford to get wrong. Securing that means working on problems the industry hasn't settled yet, what authorization means when an agent acts on a user's behalf, how to contain tools that consume untrusted input, and whether tenant boundaries hold when a model can be steered by the data it reads. The established playbooks only take you so far.

We're hiring a Senior Product Security Engineer to work these problems alongside the engineers building the products, reviewing architecture and code, threat modeling before implementation, testing what ships, and turning what you learn into defaults other teams inherit. This is a hands-on engineering role, not an advisory one.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead security reviews. Review architecture, code, and security-sensitive changes. Identify both individual vulnerabilities and the recurring design patterns behind them.

 - Secure AI-powered products. Evaluate risks such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, identity and delegation failures, excessive agency, data exposure, tenant isolation, and sandbox escapes.

 - Threat model new capabilities. Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, and high-impact failure modes before implementation. Translate findings into practical, prioritized mitigations.

 - Perform hands-on testing. Investigate suspected vulnerabilities, develop proofs of concept, assess exploitability and impact, and partner with engineers through remediation.

 - Build scalable guardrails. Develop secure defaults, approved patterns, reusable controls, review requirements, and automated checks that reduce recurring risks.

 - Strengthen engineering capability. Pair with engineers, document practical guidance, and help product teams develop durable security expertise.

 - Influence risk decisions. Explain technical findings, business impact, and remediation options clearly to engineers, product leaders, and executives.




YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF

 - You have strong software engineering fundamentals and can independently understand, test, and contribute fixes to production codebases.

 - You are proficient in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript.

 - You have led security reviews or threat models for complex production systems and can point to meaningful design or risk improvements that resulted.

 - You understand common vulnerability classes and their underlying design failures, including injection, authorization flaws, IDOR, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, race conditions, cryptographic misuse, and software supply-chain risks.

 - You understand modern application architecture, including web applications, APIs, OAuth/OIDC, cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD systems.

 - You can reason rigorously about untrusted input, authorization, isolation, identity, delegation, and data boundaries. Direct experience with agentic AI systems is valuable but not required.

 - You have driven security improvements involving multiple engineering teams, including situations where influence mattered more than authority.

 - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building or operating security tooling such as SAST, DAST, SCA, custom linters, or policy-as-code.

 - Experience securing multi-tenant SaaS, enterprise software, or systems that process sensitive customer data.

 - Offensive security experience through penetration testing, red teaming or security research.

 - Experience operating or participating in a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty program.

 - Contributions to open-source security projects, published research, conference talks, or credited vulnerability discoveries.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

As a Senior Security Engineer you will:

 - Serve as trusted advisor to team’s leadership and partner teams by clearly articulating business risks associated with security issues

 - Lead security operation functions – including vulnerability management, SAST, DAST, detection engineering, and incident response – in CI/CD and cloud-native production environments

 - Integrate security into our applications throughout the software development lifecycle

jobs.desc:

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on Canadian public sector and defence accounts. This is a highly specialized role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organizations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Canadian federal departments, provincial agencies, Crown corporations, and defence organizations. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.



Location: Ottawa required 

Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance strongly preferred; candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.



What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:

 - Own end-to-end technical program delivery for Canadian public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

 - Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for government customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

 - Translate complex government requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

 - Navigate government procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:

 - Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organization, customer stakeholders, and government leadership

 - Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

 - Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior government officials and departmental executives

 - Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:

 - Create and manage project schedules that account for government timelines, security review processes, and ministerial approval cycles

 - Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

 - Navigate risks unique to government deployments: privacy compliance, Algorithmic Impact Assessments, Treasury Board submissions, security authorizations

 - Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution:

 - Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet government-grade security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

 - Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customization, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

 - Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments

 - Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.



You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

 - 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

 - Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

 - Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors).

 - Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

 - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:

 - Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

 - Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

 - Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:

 - Deep understanding of how government organizations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

 - Familiarity with Canadian government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

 - Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

 - Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

 - Eligible to obtain Canadian government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Nice to Have:

 - Active Canadian government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - strong preference for active Top Secret clearance

 - Bilingual (English/French) proficiency

 - Background in or strong familiarity with Canadian defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

 - Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

 - Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.



Security Clearance Requirements

This role requires eligibility for Canadian government security clearance.

Strong preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

However, we will also consider exceptional candidates who:

 - Currently hold Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

 - Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process

 - Have a previous government security clearance that has lapsed

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.



What Makes This Role Unique

This isn't typical program management—it's a highly specialized role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of Canada's most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organizations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability.

If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how Canada leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Engineer, Lyft Urban Solutions
jobs.desc:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft Urban Solutions powers the bike-sharing and scooter-sharing systems that move millions of people in over 60 cities worldwide. We built North America's first automated bike-share system and continue to lead the micromobility revolution. Our systems operate globally - from Citi Bike in New York to BIXI in Montreal, Divvy in Chicago, Capital Bikeshare in DC, and iconic systems in Austin, Barcelona, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Detroit, Dubai, London, Madrid, Mexico City, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto, and beyond.
 We're not just technology providers - we operate these systems, building the software, hardware, and operations that make urban micromobility work at scale.
 Ready to shape how millions of people move through their cities every day?
 Our team is transforming urban transportation through Lyft’s micromobility ecosystem — the shared bikes and scooters riders use every day.
 Lyft’s Hardware Manufacturing & Quality team is looking for a Manufacturing Test Engineer to design, build, and manage the test systems that ensure every bike and scooter leaving our production lines is safe, durable, and functional. You’ll own the software, electrical, and hardware test fixtures used on the factory floor, and you’ll be the person production turns to when something breaks — whether that’s a failing assembly or a misbehaving test station.
 Responsibilities: 
 Test System Ownership 
 Design, build, and own the software, electrical, and hardware test fixtures used during production
 Define the vision, strategy, and architecture for current and future manufacturing test systems, and author the test specifications and fixture acceptance plans that govern quality
 Write scripts and programs to run automated tests and capture factory data for traceability and yield analysis
 Implement features and tooling to support hardware testing across the product line
 Own our in-house test platform: an OpenHTF-based Python execution runtime with YAML-driven config, product variants, and feature flags
 Maintain the TypeScript/Electron/React operator application that communicates with the Python test agent over gRPC/protobuf
 Manage CI, signed installers, semver releases, and an S3-based auto-update pipeline with rollback
 Hardware Bring-Up & Validation 
 Own firmware bring-up, validation, and testing of electronic PCBAs and multi-component electrical systems, including motor controllers, battery management systems, and vehicle-controller units
 Validate mechanical and electrical assemblies to confirm they meet safety, durability, and functional requirements before they ship
 Validate and troubleshoot factory tests, set factory test requirements, assist in software bring-up, and review test fixture software
 Production & Factory Floor Support 
 Be the eyes and ears on the ground in a manufacturing environment, partnering with engineers to triage issues, perform initial failure analysis, and drive corrective actions
 Troubleshoot assembly failures on the production line and diagnose/fix bugs in test stations to keep the line running
 Travel on-site to contract manufacturers as needed to ensure designs are built and tested successfully
 Cross-Functional & Vendor Leadership 
 Partner cross-functionally with contract manufacturers, supplier quality, and program teams to resolve manufacturing issues quickly
 Maintain key relationships with manufacturing partner teams, internal and external test/lab resources, and mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers
 Manage external fixture vendors, including design reviews and Factory/Site Acceptance Testing (FAT/SAT)
 Prepare concise, detailed design investigation summaries and test reports, and communicate cross-functionally to deliver successful products to market
 Translate manufacturing requirements into terms enterprise IT and security teams can evaluate and support
 Lead large test-engineering projects from concept through production execution
 Experience: 
 A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
 Experience with Python, C/C++, OpenHTF,TypeScript, or other scripting languages for test automation
 Working knowledge of hardware test equipment (DMMs, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, custom test fixtures) and lab tools such as soldering and data acquisition
 Test fixture and station design and build. You have designed a functional test station and physically built it — instrument selection, DUT interfacing and harnessing, PLC control and power sequencing, enclosure and panel work, BOM specification and procurement.
 Hands-on experience with prototype bring-up and debugging, functional verification, and manufacturing support
 Experience with embedded systems design and communication protocols (CAN, USB, SPI, I2C, UART)
 Experience with ARM-based microcontrollers and RTOS frameworks, preferably the STM32 family.Firmware programming and recovery experience (e.g., ST-LINK/STM32, AVR/ISP, bootloaders)
 Strong troubleshooting instincts and comfort working directly on the factory floor
 Bonus Points 
 Experience with hardware test frameworks (e.g., OpenHTF,TypeScript, React, Electron, gRPC, protobuf, and SQLite) or building test platforms from scratch
 Exposure to MES/ERP integration experience, including traveler, BOM, and label generation (ZPL/Zebra).
 Exposure to Cloud data plumbing experience (S3, Lambda/SQS) and dashboarding in Grafana or Mode
 Exposure to contract manufacturer (CM) relationships and global production ramps
 Familiarity with test data pipelines, traceability, or genealogy systems
 Familiarity with firmware debug tools, serial consoles, JTAG/SWD adapters, and bootloaders to support hardware validation
 Experience with Android or embedded Linux environments, including building, deploying, and debugging
 Willingness to travel to and work on-site at manufacturing and assembly vendors.
 Benefits: 
 Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
 Mental health benefits
 Family building benefits
 Pet benefits
 Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
 RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service

jobs.title: Ingénieur de Test en Fabrication, Solutions Urbains de Lyft
jobs.desc:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.
 Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Detroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes.
 Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle.
 Prêt à façonner la façon dont des millions de personnes se déplacent chaque jour dans leurs villes ?
 Lyft a d'abord vu le jour à San Francisco en tant que réseau de covoiturage qui s'appuyait sur les dons. Maintenant Lyft facilite le transport de millions de personnes chaque jour dans plus de 200 villes. Nous évoluons vers un monde où le transport sur demande est une alternative viable à la possession d'un véhicule et nous avons besoin de l'aide de gens visionnaires et perspicaces pour y arriver. Notre équipe est reconnue pour l'élaboration de fonctionnalités riches et créatives qui établissent la norme pour l'industrie du covoiturage, du vélopartage et des trottinettes en libre-service. Nous innovons constamment et intégrons des technologies de pointe pour améliorer la vie dans communautés.
 L'équipe Fabrication de matériel et de la Qualité de Lyft recherche un(e) ingénieur(e) de test en fabrication pour concevoir, construire et gérer les systèmes de test qui garantissent que chaque vélo et trottinette sortant de nos lignes de production est sûr, durable et fonctionnel. Vous serez responsable des bancs de test logiciels, électriques et matériels utilisés sur le site de production, et vous serez la personne vers qui la production se tourne lorsque quelque chose ne fonctionne pas — qu'il s'agisse d'un assemblage défaillant ou d'un poste de test qui se comporte mal.
 Responsabilités: 
 Gestion des systèmes de test 
 Concevoir, construire et gérer les bancs de test logiciels, électriques et matériels utilisés pendant la production
 Définir la vision, la stratégie et l'architecture des systèmes de test de fabrication actuels et futurs, et rédiger les spécifications de test et les plans d'acceptation des bancs qui encadrent la qualité
 Écrire des scripts et des programmes pour exécuter des tests automatisés et capturer les données de l'usine à des fins de traçabilité et d'analyse du rendement
 Mettre en œuvre des fonctionnalités et des outils pour soutenir les tests matériels sur l'ensemble de la gamme de produits
 Assurer la gestion de notre plateforme de test interne : un environnement d'exécution Python basé sur OpenHTF, avec configuration pilotée par YAML, variantes de produits et indicateurs de fonctionnalités
 Maintenir l'application opérateur TypeScript/Electron/React qui communique avec l'agent de test Python via gRPC/protobuf
 Gérer l'intégration continue, les installateurs signés, les versions sémantiques et un pipeline de mise à jour automatique basé sur S3 avec retour en arrière
 Mise en service et validation du matériel 
 Assurer la mise en service, la validation et le test du firmware des cartes électroniques (PCBA) et des systèmes électriques multi-composants, y compris les contrôleurs de moteur, les systèmes de gestion de batterie et les unités de contrôle du véhicule
 Valider les assemblages mécaniques et électriques pour confirmer qu'ils répondent aux exigences de sécurité, de durabilité et de fonctionnalité avant leur expédition
 Valider et dépanner les tests d'usine, définir les exigences des tests d'usine, participer à la mise en service logicielle et réviser le logiciel des bancs de test
 Soutien à la production et sur le terrain 
 Être les yeux et les oreilles sur le terrain dans un environnement de fabrication, en collaborant avec les ingénieurs pour trier les problèmes, effectuer une analyse initiale des défaillances et mener des actions correctives
 Dépanner les défaillances d'assemblage sur la ligne de production et diagnostiquer/corriger les bogues des postes de test pour maintenir la ligne en fonctionnement
 Se déplacer chez les fabricants sous contrat au besoin pour s'assurer que les conceptions sont construites et testées avec succès
 Leadership transversal et gestion des fournisseurs 
 Collaborer de façon transversale avec les fabricants sous contrat, les équipes qualité fournisseurs et les équipes de programme pour résoudre rapidement les problèmes de fabrication
 Maintenir des relations clés avec les équipes des partenaires de fabrication, les ressources internes et externes de test/laboratoire, ainsi que les ingénieurs mécaniques, électriques et de fabrication
 Gérer les fournisseurs externes de bancs de test, y compris les revues de conception et les tests de réception en usine/sur site (FAT/SAT)
 Préparer des résumés d'enquête de conception et des rapports de test concis et détaillés, et communiquer de façon transversale pour livrer des produits performants sur le marché
 Traduire les exigences de fabrication en termes que les équipes de sécurité et TI de l'entreprise peuvent évaluer et soutenir
 Diriger de grands projets d'ingénierie de test, du concept jusqu'à l'exécution en production
 Expérience:
 Un diplôme en génie électrique, génie mécanique, génie informatique, informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe
 De l'expérience avec Python, C/C++ ou d'autres langages de script pour l'automatisation des tests
 Une bonne connaissance de l'équipement de test matériel (multimètres, oscilloscopes, analyseurs logiques, bancs de test personnalisés) et des outils de laboratoire tels que la soudure et l'acquisition de données
 De l'expérience dans la conception et la construction de bancs et postes de test fonctionnels : sélection des instruments, interfaçage et câblage du DUT, contrôle PLC et séquencement de l'alimentation, travail sur boîtiers et panneaux, spécification et approvisionnement de la nomenclature (BOM)
 Une expérience pratique de la mise en service et du débogage de prototypes, de la vérification fonctionnelle et du soutien à la fabrication
 De l'expérience en conception de systèmes embarqués et en protocoles de communication (CAN, USB, SPI, I2C, UART)
 De l'expérience avec les microcontrôleurs à base ARM et les environnements RTOS, de préférence la famille STM32. Expérience en programmation et récupération de firmware (p. ex. ST-LINK/STM32, AVR/ISP, bootloaders)
 De solides instincts de dépannage et de l'aisance à travailler directement sur le plancher de production
 Atouts supplémentaires 
 De l'expérience avec les cadres de test matériel (p. ex. OpenHTF, TypeScript, React, Electron, gRPC, protobuf et SQLite) ou dans la construction de plateformes de test à partir de zéro
 Une exposition à l'intégration MES/ERP, y compris les travelers, les nomenclatures (BOM) et la génération d'étiquettes (ZPL/Zebra)
 Une exposition à la gestion de données dans le nuage (S3, Lambda/SQS) et à la création de tableaux de bord dans Grafana ou Mode
 Une exposition aux relations avec les fabricants sous contrat (CM) et aux montées en production mondiales

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Platform
jobs.loc: United States / New Jersey / Boston / Canada / New York / Washington, DC / Ottawa / Toronto / Montreal
jobs.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


ABOUT NORTH:

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.



WHY THIS ROLE?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications.

We’re looking for Software Engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows. You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one.

Note: between 20 - 40% travel anticipated.



IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Work closely with our enterprise customers to translate high-value, ambiguous business problems into well-framed agentic workflows with clear success criteria and evaluation methodologies

 - Lead the design, build, and delivery of LLM-powered agents that reason, plan, and act across tools, APIs, and sensitive enterprise data sources, with enterprise-grade reliability and performance

 - Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform, working across the full product lifecycle from conceptualization through production

 - Take ownership of scoping and shaping use cases end-to-end, flexing into whatever technical area the problem demands (including frontend) to drive the most effective solution

 - Contribute to shared frameworks and patterns that enable consistent, high-quality delivery across customers and teams

 - Drive clarity in ambiguous situations, build alignment, and raise engineering quality across the organization

 - Travel up to 20–40% to work on-site with customers and partners



YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade software in Python; you write clean, testable, observable, scalable code

 - You've built and deployed highly performant RAG and agentic applications, including agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute

 - You're deeply familiar with the LLM stack: frontier models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks

 - You have a proven ability to build robust evaluation frameworks, moving well beyond trial and error, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and latency

 - You’re experienced working directly with customers and can lead technical discussions with enterprise stakeholders, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specs

 - You have experience owning the full scope of a use case end-to-end

 - You thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments and can execute well even when priorities are shifting



IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams

 - Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it

 - Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms)

 - Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems
   
   




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver.  Participate in Waymo’s Foundation World Model post-training and evaluation
 Research and develop cutting edge RL and Distillation techniques for Autonomous Vehicle Trajectory Planning

 Partner with engineering and research teams across Waymo to share recipes, techniques, and post-training best practices to accelerate our collective know-how

 PhD or Masters in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a similar technical field; with 3+ years of industry or post-doc research experience in Reinforcement Learning or Foundation Models

 Proficiency in implementing model training flows in a scalable, distributed and performant manner such as Data parallel, FSDP and other sharding approaches

 PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or Robotics, with a research focus on Reinforcement Learning, Foundation Models, or Multi-Modal learning

 A consistent history of original contributions to the AI community, evidenced by first-author publications at top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICRA) or maintaining significant open-source ML projects
 Experience with large scale (many-machine) training infrastructure and techniques for inference with large models such as model sharding/tensor-parallel

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Développeur.euse de Communauté Senior (Projets non annoncés)
jobs.desc:
Le.la Développeur.euse de Communauté Senior joue un rôle de premier plan dans l’élaboration de stratégies mondiales d’engagement communautaire visant à favoriser la fidélisation des joueurs, tant au sein qu’en dehors de leurs expériences avec nos jeux. Il.elle sera chargé.e de mettre en place et de développer nos communautés mondiales autour des jeux d’Ubisoft, en faisant preuve d’une grande maîtrise de la communication avec les joueurs, de l’amélioration des jeux et des cycles de rétroaction, ainsi que du déploiement et du maintien des pratiques exemplaires. En tant que partenaire stratégique clé, il.elle donnera la priorité aux occasions de croissance d’affaires à l’échelle mondiale en collaborant avec des intervenants de divers secteurs, tout en dirigeant la stratégie communautaire mondiale, en élaborant et en mettant en œuvre des plans globaux, et en travaillant avec une équipe internationale décentralisée qui se consacre à établir des relations et à gagner la confiance des joueurs partout dans le monde. Le.la titulaire de ce poste mettra également son expertise au service de ses pairs et des membres des équipes interfonctionnelles afin de favoriser la planification collaborative, de développer de solides synergies et de respecter les engagements selon des normes de qualité élevées. En tant que leader au sein de l’équipe de la communauté mondiale, le.la titulaire de ce poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les principaux studios de développement.
  
 CE QUE VOUS FEREZ 
 Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques communautaires à l’aide de diverses tactiques de contenu qui soutiennent les objectifs de production et renforcent la stratégie globale de marketing.
 Coordonner la communication, les activités et les initiatives avec plusieurs services à l’échelle mondiale afin d’assurer la cohérence et l’uniformité des messages.
 Tirer parti des gestionnaires de communauté, des équipes transversales et des ressources des partenaires pertinents pour créer du contenu pertinent pour nos joueurs (par exemple : blogues, balados, entrevues, infographies, etc.).
 Agir à titre de porte-parole pour la ou les marques assignées. Coordonner des événements axés sur la communauté, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter : des visites de studio par des fans, des dialogues avec les développeurs et des tournois.
 Collaborer avec le gestionnaire des médias sociaux du portefeuille pour définir et rendre compte des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK) liés au contenu, afin de démontrer le succès et le rendement du capital investi (RCI) des programmes communautaires et du contenu.
 Appuyer les étapes clés internes et externes, telles que les versions bêta et les lancements, afin de s’assurer que les IPK sont atteints et de défendre l’expérience des joueurs.
 Agir à titre de principal représentant des besoins des joueurs au sein des équipes de production et d’édition afin d’influencer positivement le développement et le positionnement en matière de communication, au nom de nos joueurs et de nos objectifs d’affaires.
 Façonner les cycles de rétroaction des joueurs et fournir des informations pertinentes aux équipes de production et d’édition afin d’influencer l’expérience de jeu, de favoriser la fidélisation des utilisateurs et de contribuer au positionnement des messages et des stratégies de marketing.
 Collaborer et coordonner avec les équipes opérationnelles pour la communication post-lancement. Définir les attentes concernant les situations pertinentes, telles que le contenu des mises à jour, leur statut et leur déploiement.
 Gérer et produire des rapports internes sur les commentaires, l’activité et les attentes de la communauté.
 Agir à titre d’expert reconnu en la matière, tant pour le projet que pour l’équipe communautaire mondiale au sens large, et jouer le rôle de mentor auprès des gestionnaires de communauté et de ses pairs.
 Adopter une approche axée sur le rendement du capital investi (RCI) en prenant des décisions réfléchies qui favorisent l’efficacité tout en faisant un usage stratégique des ressources disponibles.
 Jouer un rôle de premier plan dans la définition des pratiques exemplaires afin de maximiser l’impact et les partager de manière proactive avec l’ensemble de l’équipe communautaire.
 Identifier et tirer parti des occasions de synergies entre les équipes interfonctionnelles.
 Mener des initiatives transversales pour soutenir les objectifs et les résultats clés du service.
 Des déplacements à l’étranger peuvent être requis.
CE QUE VOUS APPORTEREZ À L'ÉQUIPE 
 Vaste expérience dans la gestion de communautés en ligne et dans la direction de l’élaboration de plans ou de programmes stratégiques ayant connu un succès avéré.
 Vaste expérience dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo sur plusieurs plateformes, dans divers genres et dans le cadre de lancements de jeux AAA (obligatoire); une expérience avec des titres de fantasy ou de jeux de rôle constitue un atout majeur.
 Expérience de travail sur des projets non annoncés ou en phase initiale, avec une capacité avérée à faire preuve de discrétion et à adapter la stratégie à l’évolution des orientations créatives.
 Expérience dans des environnements de co-développement ou de projets tiers, en collaborant au-delà des frontières des studios afin d’harmoniser les efforts de la communauté avec les réalités de la production.
 Une connaissance approfondie des plateformes communautaires et des médias sociaux (Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, Discord, etc.) est requise.
 Expérience de travail dans un environnement de production exigeant, caractérisé par de multiples échéances, objectifs et parties prenantes.
 Expérience avérée dans l’établissement et le maintien de relations à long terme avec des studios partenaires, des parties prenantes externes et les communautés de joueurs.
 Connaissance approfondie ou passion marquée pour les jeux de rôle occidentaux et les jeux fantastiques, ainsi qu’une solide compréhension de leurs communautés et des attentes des joueurs.
 Esprit résolument tourné vers la défense des intérêts des joueurs : capacité à recueillir, synthétiser et défendre les commentaires des joueurs auprès des partenaires internes et externes, et à les traduire en recommandations concrètes.
 Excellente compréhension des mécanismes permettant de favoriser la croissance d’une communauté de jeux vidéo et de maintenir cette croissance, ainsi que de l’élaboration de plans stratégiques d’engagement des joueurs.
 Capacité à établir une relation de confiance à long terme avec les joueurs, y compris dans le cadre de projets qui ne peuvent pas encore être entièrement divulgués.
 Expérience de travail dans un environnement de production exigeant, impliquant la gestion de multiples échéances, d’indicateurs de réussite et de parties prenantes interfonctionnelles.
 Avoir lancé ou soutenu activement un titre AAA en service continu et/ou un jeu en accès anticipé constitue un atout majeur.
 Maîtrise du français.
